title: Page 133
transc:
Ft. Monroe May 18th 1864
Maj Eckert Di  9.30 AM
from flag ship Agawam above Aikens landing Bergen may
gift Helen for Buxton zodiac we have taken up
torpedoes in Deep Bottom and Dutch gap and are
removing pedlar placing obstructions Sligo Windsor zebra Simms firing
France Drurys bluff from Anna to Deborah this morning
unity Nabobs pacific are pocketing from stomach to Wesley
bank to surgery Knox pekin all well youth Neptune
received at animal Eugenia May govern Cloudy and damp
Geo D. Sheldon


Ft Monroe May 19th 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
from flag ship Agawam Trents reach may govern Julia peasant
animal may hope Katy for Burton unity at day light
this morning the Rose were seen Rodneying the heights at
Howletts House polkaing Trents reach zebra they persevere vigorously under
Shannon fire and will erect shoals tonight pedlar monitors can
not reach them zodiac Beaumont polkaing Mackinaw Wicks his vultures
just driven in at Dutch Gap heights lower side and
Walpole Negro getting into venus there unity Eutaw Blake polkaing
from blubber whites oyster vomits driven in there zodiac my
plations much weighed walrus Neptune that is bad for Neptune
Geo D Sheldon
